title: Solve a published Moving AI task
inputs: Bundled original city map and scenario; canonical movingai:0 (zero-based index 0).
requirements: Base runtime, accessible source versions, finite runner budget. A* and Dijkstra are available.
evidence: A new route, original provenance and independently recomputed grid validity and published optimal length; no body dynamics.

title: Check saved navigation episodes
inputs: Existing catalog episodes in the selected domain; these are saved recordings.
requirements: Existing complete source records and inspection rights. No download or reimport is performed.
evidence: Record structure and stored integrity; the saved labels do not become newly demonstrated task outcomes.

title: Export navigation recordings
inputs: Existing episodes and their complete linked groups.
requirements: Source export permission, owner grant, space within the artifact ceiling; existing IDs/groups/splits stay unchanged.
evidence: Checked episodes.jsonl and dataset-manifest.json; dataset integrity, not new robotics execution.

title: Check saved manipulation episodes
inputs: Existing catalog episodes in the selected domain; these are saved recordings.
requirements: Existing complete source records and inspection rights. No download or reimport is performed.
evidence: Record structure and stored integrity; the saved labels do not become newly demonstrated task outcomes.

title: Export manipulation recordings
inputs: Existing episodes and their complete linked groups.
requirements: Source export permission, owner grant, space within the artifact ceiling; existing IDs/groups/splits stay unchanged.
evidence: Checked episodes.jsonl and dataset-manifest.json; dataset integrity, not new robotics execution.

title: View recorded Can states
inputs: One existing Can episode ID from find_resources.
requirements: The retained catalog payload. No simulator is needed; state vectors are not policy observations.
evidence: A window of recorded states with original indices. No actions are executed and replay is not established.

title: Execute recorded Can actions in a simulator
inputs: Existing Can episode, exact XML model and versioned controller/state supplement.
requirements: Pinned can-replay extra and accepted model: 71 values = time + 37 qpos + 33 qvel; OSC_POSE, 20 Hz, world input frame. Unknown control/frame semantics block replay.
evidence: Initial state is loaded once, then actions execute headlessly. Independent PickPlaceCan object/bin/gripper geometry is checked separately from recorded reward/done. This is simulator execution, never physical replay.

title: Evaluate registered XYZ trajectories
inputs: One registered asset containing prediction and reference XYZ tracks with equal timestamps; register_trajectory accepts paired TUM files.
requirements: Explicit shared coordinate frame and metres, appropriate rights and a supplied reference. No automatic spatial/time alignment. MCAP is rejected for this operation.
evidence: Unaligned position RMSE against the supplied reference and threshold, independently recomputed; no inferred flight outcome.

title: Inspect a ROS/MCAP sensor recording
inputs: Existing registered ROS1/ROS2 MCAP bytes and declared source revision, frame, units and platform.
requirements: Register through register_sensor_recording (at most 1 MiB input), with source permissions. The source URL is provenance, not an automatic download.
evidence: Original timestamps and message inventory with exact decimal-string nanoseconds. No invented control command, trajectory reference or flight success.

title: Run the published falling-ball engine task
inputs: Bundled pinned Pymunk basic_test task, canonical pymunk:basic_test:7.2.0.
requirements: pymunk 7.2.0 and the native-engine version from the profile. Headless, finite runner limits.
evidence: The actual engine runs; a Pymunk-free verifier checks states and removal below y=0 in pixel units. No real-world equivalence.

title: Build a navigation dataset generation
inputs: Existing exact episode IDs, including every member of each selected group.
requirements: Pinned reader/runtime when using LeRobot (see profile); source export rights. Training purpose accepts only train records; normalization uses train data only.
evidence: Immutable DatasetManifest, preserved values/time/groups/rights/provenance and checked format round trip. Named observations remain observations; no training or task execution.
